shortDescription: Pakistan had negotiated with Iran to secure safe passage for liquefied natural gas carrier Al Mayeda before it was attacked near the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, Bloomberg reported, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Iran Approved Passage for Pakistan LNG Carrier Attacked Near Hormuz
